features.name: Core library
features.behavior: core/ ships the ai_app_chassis package: provider port, deterministic fake provider, LiteLLM adapter (optional extra), LLMClient with per-step routing, validated structured output with one retry and a call ledger, versioned prompt store, input guardrails and PII redaction, and a golden-set eval runner whose JSON report a quality gate can read.
features.verification: pytest covers every module except the LiteLLM adapter; mypy strict and ruff pass; arch-101 keeps the core free of app, web framework and SDK imports.

features.name: Example app template
features.behavior: template/backend is a FastAPI service built only on the core public API: POST /summarize (guardrails, PII redaction, versioned prompt, structured output), GET /usage (ledger summary) and GET /health; it runs on the fake model by default and on any LiteLLM model through APP_MODEL, and ships a five-case golden set with a keyword-recall eval.
features.verification: API tests cover success, PII redaction, guardrail 422s and the invalid-model 502; the eval writes a report the eval-summarize gate reads; coverage and eval gates pass.

features.name: create-app generator
features.behavior: npm run create-app -- <dir> [--name <kebab-name>] generates a new app: the harness adopted (devcontainer and mcp components), template/backend copied to backend/ with the package renamed after the project, root files from template/scaffold/, npm scripts, quality gates, CI and dev container wired for Python, and the core pinned to this repository at the current commit (or a local core with --core-path).
features.verification: tools/tests/create-app.test.mjs checks the generated tree (renamed package, filled placeholders, scripts, productRoots, harness-only arch rules, CI and dev container) and that the harness lint and manifest pass on it; tools/tests/create-app.e2e.mjs (in npm run e2e) installs a generated app and runs its own npm run check and check-arch.

features.name: Frontend in the template
features.behavior: template/frontend is a React + Vite UI for the template backend: a summarize form that shows the summary and keywords, names the guardrail that rejected an input (422) or reports a model failure (502), and shows the model and the usage totals. It calls /api/*, which the Vite dev server forwards to the backend. Its typecheck, tests and build run in the chassis layers, and create-app copies it to frontend/ in every new app.
features.verification: Vitest + Testing Library cover the summarize flow, the guardrail and model errors, the unreachable backend and the API client; npm run typecheck/test/build include the frontend; create-app tests check frontend/ in a generated app, and the e2e check installs it and runs its npm run check.

features.name: Optional RAG module
features.behavior: core gains ai_app_chassis.rag: paragraph-aware chunking with overlapping windows, an Embedder and a VectorStore port, a deterministic HashingEmbedder (pure Python, no key), an optional LiteLLMEmbedder, an in-memory cosine store, a Retriever (chunks or distinct documents), recall@k and reciprocal rank; python -m ai_app_chassis.rag_eval scores retrieval of a folder of documents against a golden set and writes a report a quality gate reads.
features.verification: core/tests/test_rag.py and test_rag_eval.py cover chunking, the embedder, the store, the retriever, the metrics and the CLI; the eval-retrieval gate keeps recall@3 on core/evals/retrieval/ at or above 0.9; coverage stays above 90; create-app drops chassis-only scripts.
